finalModelMessage:
Registration did not complete. What stopped me:

1. On `/inaccessible`, **Register** is not exposed as a button or link (clicks by those roles timed out). I only reached the form by guessing `/inaccessible/register/accessible-forms`.
2. I set attendee name to **Jordan Lee** and first submitted with **jordan-not-an-email**. The accessibility tree did **not** show a validation error; the form stayed the same.
3. Meal preference is only the text “Meal preference…” — no combobox/select with a label, so I could not choose a meal.
4. The terms control is an unnamed checkbox, so I could not check it.
5. Tool budget ran out before a second submit.

No confirmation code was given.
